title: Wasdo: Keyboard Mouse Mapper
shortDescription: Play mobile games PC-style: WASD, key mapping, presets. No root, no ADB, no PC
tagline: Keyboard Mouse Mapper for Mobile Games: No Root, No ADB

sections.title: Keyboard Mouse Mapper for Mobile Games: No Root, No ADB
paragraphs: Wasdo is a keyboard mouse mapper that lets you play with keyboard and mouse on Android phones and tablets. Connect a USB or Bluetooth keyboard and mouse, place keys over the game's buttons and play touch games the PC way: WASD to move, the mouse to turn the camera, keys for skills and weapons. No root, no ADB, no PC and no wireless debugging pairing. Turn on one Accessibility permission and play.

sections.title: No Root, No ADB, No Activation
paragraphs: Many keyboard and mouse apps make you pair wireless debugging, run ADB from a computer or activate again after every restart. Wasdo doesn't.
bullets: Only the Accessibility service, no Shizuku or helper app
No pairing codes, no USB debugging, no PC
Nothing to activate again after a reboot
Works on Android phones and tablets

sections.title: Popular Ways People Use Wasdo
bullets: Shooters on a tablet: WASD movement, mouse look, keys to reload and crouch
MOBA games with skill keys and smart cast
Action RPGs with dodge and skill combos on the keyboard
A tablet with a keyboard case, or a phone on a USB hub

sections.title: Key Mapping: Tap, Hold, Turbo and Swipe
bullets: Use it as a keyboard mapper: map any key to a tap, hold, turbo or swipe
Trigger on press, long press, double tap or release
WASD joystick with eight directions and a sprint key
Map left, right, middle and side mouse buttons
Click at the cursor for menus, maps and inventory

sections.title: Mouse Look and Camera Control
bullets: Camera mode locks the mouse and turns the view, like a PC game
Press Esc to switch between camera and cursor mode
Change sensitivity mid-match with a slider or hotkeys
Invert Y, scope key and an optional crosshair

sections.title: Presets and Templates for FPS, MOBA and RPG
bullets: Ready-made presets for popular games, fitted to your screen shape
FPS, MOBA, open-world action and General templates
Drag-and-drop editor, adjustable key size and opacity
Several layouts per game
Export, backup and share codes are free

sections.title: Typing Mode, Floating Pill and Stream Mode
bullets: Typing mode (Enter) sends your keyboard to the game chat
Floating pill: switch layouts, tune sensitivity, edit keys in game
Stream mode hides the overlay while you record

sections.title: Wasdo Pro: Advanced Mouse and Macro Controls
paragraphs: Free to start, no ads. Wasdo Pro adds unlimited games and layouts, modifier combos (Shift, Ctrl or Alt + key), sensitivity curves with separate X and Y, smoothing and scope zoom, scroll wheel keys, one-key macros, scene switching, toggle and sequence keys, and MOBA smart cast. Layouts you've saved keep working.

sections.title: Privacy and the Accessibility Permission
paragraphs: Wasdo uses the Accessibility service only to read your keyboard and mouse while a mapping runs and to place touches on the game. It doesn't read, store or upload your screen.

sections.title: Please Note
bullets: Some games detect external keyboards and mice and may restrict accounts. Wasdo doesn't hide itself or bypass this. Games reported by players are tagged in the app.
No recoil control or aim assist. Wasdo only turns your own input into touches.
Touchpads can't turn the camera. Use a regular mouse.
External displays work in mirroring mode, not Samsung DeX desktop mode.
For controllers, try our sister app Gamepad Pro.
Game names belong to their owners. Wasdo isn't affiliated with any publisher.

sections.title: Something Not Working?
paragraphs: Run Settings → Keyboard & mouse self-check first. Still stuck? Email feedback@dapplebyte.com with your phone model and game before leaving a review. We read every message.
